VOrigin looks for brands with a sound foundation, a credible story and clear room to grow in Vietnam. The aim is to build a lasting market presence together, not simply move a shipment.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

What VOrigin looks for in a brand

Clear Provenance

Provenance, manufacturer and documentation that can be clearly verified.

Defined Standards

Consistent quality and standards clear enough to support long-term growth.

Market Relevance

A clear fit with Vietnamese consumers and the channels that serve them.

Long-term Potential

The potential to build a brand, not simply complete a shipment.

HOW WE WORK

We begin by understanding the brand.

We begin with the product itself — its provenance, documentation, standards and ambitions — before we discuss channels. That creates a clearer view of fit, the right route to market and where localisation can add value without diluting the brand.
